title: Immigration (E3, en)
text:
Immigration sharply declined.

By this time, anti-immigration sentiments in the U.S. became so strong that a growing number of people demanded laws to make it harder for foreigners to become U.S. citizens.

In 1882, Congress also passed the Chinese Exclusion Act.

From about 1820 to 1870, millions of people made the voyage to the United States, mostly from northern and western Europe.
